arxiv-1909-08085.title: Prototype operations of atmospheric calibration devices for the Cherenkov Telescope Array
arxiv-1909-08085.creator: Dušan Mandát, Miroslav Pech, Ladislav Chytka, Jakub Juryšek, Michael Prouza, Petr Janeček, Petr Trávníček, Jiří Blažek, Markus Gaug for the CTA consortium, Martin Mašek, Jiří Eliášek, Sergey Karpov
arxiv-1909-08085.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Dušan Mandát, Miroslav Pech, Ladislav Chytka, Jakub Juryšek, Michael Prouza, Petr Janeček, Petr Trávníček, Jiří Blažek, Markus Gaug for the CTA consortium, Martin Mašek, Jiří Eliášek, Sergey Karpov. The atmospheric monitoring devices for the planned calibration system of the Cherenkov Telescope Array (CTA) are undergoing intensive development, prototyping and testing.

arxiv-2109-12429.title: A new graph decomposition method for bipartite graphs
arxiv-2109-12429.creator: Béla Csaba
arxiv-2109-12429.description: Abstract Given a sufficiently large and sufficiently dense bipartite graph G = ( A , B , E ) , G=(A,B;E), we present a novel method for decomposing the majority of the edges of G G into quasirandom graphs so that the vertex sets of these quasirandom graphs partition the majority of A . A.

arxiv-2111-06841.title: A posteriori learning of quasi-geostrophic turbulence parametrization: an experiment on integration steps
arxiv-2111-06841.creator: Hugo Frezat, Julien Le Sommer, Ronan Fablet, Guillaume Balarac, Redouane Lguensat
arxiv-2111-06841.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hugo Frezat, Julien Le Sommer, Ronan Fablet, Guillaume Balarac, Redouane Lguensat. Modeling the subgrid-scale dynamics of reduced models is a long standing open problem that finds application in ocean, atmosphere and climate predictions where direct numerical simulation (DNS) is impossible. While neural networks (NNs) have already been applied to a range of three-dimensional flows with success, two dimensional flows are more challenging because of the backscatter of energy from small to large scales.

arxiv-2201-00502.title: Energy Conditions in Non-minimally Coupled f ⁡ ( R , T ) f(R,T) Gravity Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2201-00502.creator: P.K. Sahoo*, Sanjay Mandal, Simran Arora
arxiv-2201-00502.description: Abstract In today’s scenario, going beyond Einstein’s theory of gravity leads us to some more complete and modified gravity theories. One of them is the f ⁡ ( R , T ) f(R,T) gravity in which R R is the Ricci scalar, and T T is the trace of the energy-momentum tensor.

arxiv-2211-11833.title: Inclusive semileptonic B B -decays from lattice QCD
arxiv-2211-11833.creator: Nazario Tantalo
arxiv-2211-11833.description: Abstract We present the lattice QCD calculation of inclusive semileptonic B s B_{s} -meson decays. We follow a recently proposed method, which is based on the extraction of smeared spectral densities from Euclidean correlation functions and on the numerical reconstruction of the integration kernel relevant for the inclusive decay rate calculation.

arxiv-2303-09964.title: Almost toric presentations of symplectic log Calabi-Yau pairs
arxiv-2303-09964.creator: Tian-Jun Li, Jie Min, Shengzhen Ning
arxiv-2303-09964.description: Abstract It’s known ( [ Sym03 ] ) that the union of fibers over elliptic singularities of an almost toric fibered (ATF) symplectic four-manifold gives a symplectic log Calabi-Yau (LCY) divisor. In this note, we show the converse also holds: any symplectic log Calabi-Yau divisor can be realized as the boundary divisor of an almost toric fibration.

arxiv-2412-06577.title: Effect of simple shear on knotted polymer coils and globules
arxiv-2412-06577.creator: Andrey Milchev, Maurice P. Schmitt, Peter Virnau
arxiv-2412-06577.description: Abstract We explore the effect of Couette flow on knotted linear polymer chains with extensive Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations. Hydrodynamic interactions are accounted for by means of Multi-Particle Collision Dynamics (MPCD). The polymer chain, containing originally a simple trefoil knot at rest, is described by a coarse-grained bead-spring model in a coil or globular state.

arxiv-2511-01646.title: On the Fibonacci-Lucas Ground State Degeneracies of the One-Dimensional Antiferromagnetic Ising Model at Criticality
arxiv-2511-01646.creator: Bastian Castorene, Francisco J. Peña, Patricio Vargas
arxiv-2511-01646.description: Abstract This work examines the one-dimensional antiferromagnetic Ising model in a longitudinal magnetic field, comparing open-chain and closed-ring geometries. At the nontrivial quantum critical point (QCP) B crit = B / J = 2 B_{\mathrm{crit}}=B/J=2 , we perform a microcanonical analysis of the ground-state manifold and explicitly count the number of degenerate configurations.

arxiv-2601-09431.title: A measurement-based protocol for the generation of delocalised quantum states of a mechanical system
arxiv-2601-09431.creator: Matteo Bordin
arxiv-2601-09431.description: Abstract Non-Gaussian mechanical states are a key resource for quantum-enhanced sensing and tests of macroscopic quantum physics. We propose a measurement-based protocol to herald delocalized, nonclassical states of a mechanical oscillator in cavity optomechanics by conditioning on Geiger photodetection of the optical output. We analyse under which conditions Stokes-induced optomechanical entanglement gives rise to mechanical Wigner Function negativity upon detection.

britannica-1911-solon.title: Solon (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-solon.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-solon.description: Article 'Solon' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of Execestides of the family of Codrus, was born about 638 B.C. The prodigality of his father made it necessary for Solon to maintain himself by trade, especially abroad. In his youth he became well known as the author of amatory poems and later of patriotic and didactic verse. Hence his inclusion among the Seven Sages.

pmc-10536932.title: Maturity Assessment of Different Table Grape Cultivars Grown at Six Different Altitudes in Lebanon
pmc-10536932.creator: Najwane Hamie, Diana Nacouzi, Mariam Choker, Maya Salameh, Linda Darwiche, Walid El Kayal, Georgia Ouzounidou, Miltiadis V Christopoulos
pmc-10536932.description: Table grapes are harvested based on well-known maturity indices that must be monitored after fruit veraison. The aim of this study was to assess these indices across multiple locations and environmental conditions, encompassing different table grape cultivars such as Black Pearl, Crimson Seedless, Superior Seedless, and Red Globe.

pmc-11354108.title: Social–Emotional Profiles of Preschool Children: An Investigation of Demographic Disparities and Intersectionality
pmc-11354108.creator: Chin-Chih Chen, Yaoying Xu, Jennifer LoCasale-Crouch, Yuyan Xia, Kathleen Rudasill, Lindai Xie, Karli Johansen, Jeen Joy, Jennifer Askue-Collins
pmc-11354108.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study aims to enhance our understanding of the diverse nature of social–emotional development and explore the demographic disparities and intersectionality of social determinants among children, with an emphasis on underserved populations of children in low-resource environments. Young children living in low-income families are exposed to a wide array of social and systemic risks that increase the propensity for poor learning and social–emotional development.

pmc-11437007.title: Evaluation of post-treatment after wastewater stabilization ponds at municipal wastewater treatment plant
pmc-11437007.creator: Szymon Kilian, Katarzyna Pawęska, Aleksandra Bawiec
pmc-11437007.description: The primary objective of this study was to assess the operational conditions of the municipal wastewater treatment system. This system comprises a wastewater treatment plant that employs the activated sludge process, along with wastewater stabilization ponds as the third stage of treatment. The operating conditions of the wastewater stabilization ponds were observed during both normal operation and malfunction scenarios.

pmc-11505175.title: The Utility of Indocyanine Green Angiography in Breast Reconstruction to Detect Mastectomy Skin Flap Necrosis and Free Flap Perfusion: An Umbrella Review
pmc-11505175.creator: Nicholas Fadell, Flora Laurent, Sai Anusha Sanka, Esther Ochoa, Lauren Yaeger, Xiaowei Li, Matthew D Wood, Justin M Sacks, Saif Badran, Joris A van Dongen, Steven L Goudy
pmc-11505175.description: Two of the greatest challenges in breast reconstruction are mastectomy skin flap necrosis (MSFN) and autologous flap failure. This review summarizes current evidence regarding the usage of indocyanine green angiography (ICGA) in breast reconstruction, identifies knowledge gaps, and provides directions for future studies.

pmc-11508653.title: Microfilm Coatings: A Biomaterial-Based Strategy for Modulating Femoral Deflection
pmc-11508653.creator: Ana Elisabeth Olivares-Hernandez, Miguel Angel Olivares-Robles, Juan Vicente Méndez-Méndez, Claudia Gutiérrez-Camacho, Emad Moeendarbary
pmc-11508653.description: Wear on the surface of the femoral head increases the risk of hip and femur fractures. Biomechanical experiments conducted on the femur are based on its bending and torsional rigidities. Studies regarding the deflection of the femur bone when the femoral head is coated with microfilms composed of durable and compatible biomaterials are poor.

pmc-11621671.title: Dysphagia due to Lyme Disease: A Case Report
pmc-11621671.creator: Pureum Kim, Seong Hoon Lim, Jong In Lee, Ho-geon Namgung, Donghwan Kim, Eun Ji Lee
pmc-11621671.description: Lyme disease is a multisystem infection that can affect the joints, heart, and nervous system when untreated. While it can present with cranial nerve palsy, dysphagia is rarely reported. This case highlights a rare instance of dysphagia in Lyme disease, typically known for neurological symptoms like facial nerve palsy.

pmc-12563701.title: The Relationship Between Technology Use and Medication Access in Older Adults in Puerto Rico
pmc-12563701.creator: Joseph Badillo-Salcedo, Gabriela M Vélez-Jiménez, Ethan G Rosado-Martínez, Kyle Melin, Jonathan Hernández-Agosto, Jimmy T Efird
pmc-12563701.description: The recent shift from in-person to digital pharmacy services is transforming how patients interact with their pharmacists but has the potential to disadvantage older adults (aged ≥ 65) who often face barriers when using technology. This study aimed to assess digital inequalities affecting medication access among older adults.

pmc-12738800.title: Heavy metal removal by hydrogel synthesized from rice bran/acrylic acid/sodium alginate
pmc-12738800.creator: Gui-Bing Hong, Yue-hui Lin, Wang-De Lin
pmc-12738800.description: This study reports the synthesis of a novel hydrogel adsorbent prepared from rice bran (RB), acrylic acid (AA), and sodium alginate (SA) for the removal of Cu²⁺ and Ni²⁺ from aqueous solutions. RB, an abundant agricultural by-product rich in cellulose and functional groups, was combined with SA and polymerized with AA to produce a cost-effective, eco-friendly, and reusable adsorbent.

pmc-13173965.title: Biochef: a client-side WebAssembly-based workflow builder for genomic data analysis
pmc-13173965.creator: Joaquim Rosa, João Andrade, Jorge Miguel Silva, José Luis Oliveira
pmc-13173965.description: BackgroundGenomics analyses often rely on command-line tools executed via remote servers, imposing usability barriers for non-technical users and raising privacy concerns. WebAssembly (WASM) enables native-code execution directly in web browsers, eliminating installations and data transfers.ResultsWe introduce BioChef, a client-side genomic workflow platform that uses WASM.

pmc-13188691.title: scDEBGCL: a deep embedding approach based on bipartite graph contrastive learning for single-cell RNA-seq data
pmc-13188691.creator: Jing Wang, Delei Ke, Junfeng Xia, Ao Liu, Yansen Su, Chun-Hou Zheng
pmc-13188691.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSingle-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) allows for the measurement of gene expression at the transcriptomic level with single-cell precision, thereby deepening our comprehension of cellular heterogeneity. However, the high dimensionality and sparsity of scRNA-seq data impede downstream analyses (such as cell clustering and trajectory inference), and learning effective embedded representations of the data has become a key aspect in scRNA-seq data analysis.ResultWe present scDEBGCL, a novel deep embedding algorithm based on bipartite graph contrastive learning.

pmc-13241802.title: A Blind Spot in Post‐Liver Transplant Care: Correlation and Causation in Immunosuppression, Drug Monitoring, and Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor‐Related Rejection
pmc-13241802.creator: Björn Nashan
pmc-13241802.description: ship. Causation, by contrast, means that a change in one variable directly produces or influences a change in the other. The well‐known principle that “correlation does not imply causation” underscores that two events occurring together do not necessarily indicate that one causes the other—both could be influenced by a third, unobserved factor.

pmc-13403521.title: First Record of South American Sea Lion Predation on Non-Native Chinook Salmon at a Spawning Site in a Northern Patagonian River
pmc-13403521.creator: Cristóbal Garcés, Carlos Vega, Pablo Fierro
pmc-13403521.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryChinook salmon (Oncorhynchus tshawytscha) is an invasive fish that is now widespread in southern South America. Its establishment has created new ecological interactions in both freshwater and marine environments. Here, we report the first documented observation of a South American sea lion (Otaria byronia) preying on spawning Chinook salmon in a freshwater river of southern Chile, approximately 160 km from the sea and well beyond the species’ typical coastal habitat.
